# The sample user project. Historically built mygame.cpp directly; the
# project has since migrated to Lync (entry = src/_zues_main.lync, auto-
# generated by the editor). Skip the C++ target when the cpp source is
# absent so the engine still configures.
if(EXISTS "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/src/mygame.cpp")
    # IMPORTANT: MyGame links ONLY Engine::project_api (the pure-C boundary).
    # It must NOT link Engine::core - see docs/04-dll-safety.md.
    add_library(mygame SHARED src/mygame.cpp)
    add_library(zues::mygame ALIAS mygame)

    target_link_libraries(mygame PRIVATE zues::project_api)

    set_target_properties(mygame PROPERTIES
        CXX_VISIBILITY_PRESET      hidden
        VISIBILITY_INLINES_HIDDEN  ON
        PREFIX                     ""
        OUTPUT_NAME                "mygame")

    zues_set_target_flags(mygame)
endif()
